findings.description: SMTP session on port 25 carried no TLS encryption at any point (credentials and message content sent in cleartext).
findings.recommendation: Enforce mandatory TLS -- either move the service to an implicit-TLS port or configure the server to require STARTTLS before accepting authentication/mail commands.
Use the ML class as analyst context; deterministic findings remain the scoring source of truth.

findings.description: Server advertised STARTTLS support but the client session proceeded in plaintext anyway.
findings.recommendation: Enforce STARTTLS on the server -- reject AUTH/mail commands until TLS has been negotiated (many MTAs support a 'require STARTTLS' setting for exactly this).
Use the ML class as analyst context; deterministic findings remain the scoring source of truth.
